visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged woman with meticulously styled dark hair and subtle makeup is framed in a medium shot. She wears a vibrant blouse with colorful floral patterns and traditional Chinese frog closures. Her facial expressions are animated, with frequent smiles and direct eye contact with the camera. Her hands move rhythmically to emphasize her speech, occasionally pointing towards the on-screen text overlays. The setting is an indoor studio decorated with ornate wooden latticework, red silk lanterns, and traditional Chinese calligraphy scrolls, creating a warm and cultural atmosphere. Bright, even studio lighting eliminates harsh shadows. Red and gold text boxes appear on the left side of the screen. (2) The camera angle remains eye-level but the visual layout shifts as a list of 'three important customs' appears on screen. The woman continues to speak, her gestures becoming more expansive as she counts off the points using her fingers. The background remains consistent, but several small variety-style captions pop up near her shoulders to highlight key terms. Her posture is upright and welcoming. (3) The shot cuts slightly closer to a medium close-up, focusing on her facial expressions as she recites a mantra. Her hands are pressed together in a prayer-like gesture at chest level. She closes her eyes briefly then re-opens them with a warm gaze. The lighting remains bright and consistent across the studio. (4) The final phase transitions to a full-screen graphic background. A cute 3D-style animated gold snake wearing a traditional red vest and holding a red lantern stands on the right. Large gold characters for 'Golden Snake Welcomes Spring' are centered. A URL and a '2025' logo are visible at the bottom.

The speaker, an expert in the field, provides a structured overview of auspicious zodiac signs, cultural taboos, and specific rituals like receiving the Wealth God and chanting mantras to attract prosperity and success in the coming year.
